definitions.explanation: The amount by which things differ.
Added to adjective stems to express degree.

examples.japanese: {年齢|ねんれい}の{差|さ}は10{歳|さい}だ。
{貧富|ひんぷ}の{差|さ}が{広|ひろ}がっている。
examples.english: The gap between rich and poor is widening.

examples.japanese: この{高|たか}さは{何|なん}メートルですか。
examples.english: How many meters is this height?

notes:
{差|さ} expresses difference or, as a suffix, degree.

AS 'DIFFERENCE':
- {年齢|ねんれい}{差|さ} (age difference)
- {個人|こじん}{差|さ} (individual differences)
- {時間|じかん}{差|さ} (time difference)
- {価格|かかく}{差|さ} (price difference)
- {貧富|ひんぷ}の{差|さ} (gap between rich and poor)

AS SUFFIX (〜さ):
- {高|たか}さ (height - from {高|たか}い)
- {広|ひろ}さ (width - from {広|ひろ}い)
- {美|うつく}しさ (beauty - from {美|うつく}しい)
- {難|むずか}しさ (difficulty - from {難|むずか}しい)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {差|さ}がある (there is a difference)
- {差|さ}をつける (to make a difference)
- {差|さ}が{縮|ちぢ}まる (the gap narrows)
